'''Dinkle Togpipe''' was a [[gnome]] who was killed by [[murloc]]s at the landing pad on an island in the [[Ruined Reaches]] out to the east of [[Azshara]]. He was the one last in possession of the [[Flaxwhisker Front]]'s flight logbook.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|50|The Flight Logbook}}</ref>
